Unavailable-on-native affordances intentionally omitted + documented: WidgetShell's pulse-on-data-change box-shadow glow (web justUpdated/prevUpdatedAt useEffect) is a CSS shadow transition with no native analog; the help-tooltip and pin-button header slots are unused by this widget and not modeled. RN best-practice divergence: the standard layout is one outer ScrollView (web `overflow-y-auto`), and the risk list's `max-h-40 overflow-y-auto` + WidgetTipCards' `overflow-y-auto` are subsumed by it (their roots render as plain Views) to avoid a same-axis nested scroll; `truncate` -> numberOfLines={1}; StatCard's items-baseline -> alignItems:'flex-end'; the unused StatCard icon/trend/sublabel/unit/loading affordances are omitted. No DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported; only RN primitives (View/ScrollView/StyleSheet/AppText), the converted web-parity Badge + DataFreshness ports, the useBatteryDegradation/useVehicles parity hooks, and theme tokens are used.
